paragraphs: N5 Sensors sells chemical detection built on a semiconductor-grade sensing core that converts chemical exposure into machine-readable signals. The SPH array generates a chemical fingerprint across a broad range of hazards, and edge AI classifies chemical events in real time on the device. Alerts and analytics stream to the N5 Dashboard, with OTA updates that expand detection without hardware changes.

One sensing core supports three platforms: ChemNode for fixed or portable use, ChemBadge MX for handheld or wearable use, and ChemShield for rapidly deployable mesh networks. Data from multiple platforms is integrated into one cloud-native tool that offers real time monitoring in one interface and an API-first design.

The site lists applications in Defense & Homeland Security, Venues & Live Events, and Transportation & Infrastructure. The application groups given are Defense & CBRN, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Event Safety, and Transportation Safety, covering warfighter protection, base security, chemical accidents and gas leaks. The company lists an address at 9605 Medical Center Dr, Ste 200, Rockville, MD 20850.
